title: Generative 3D Forms/Sounds
text: A custom software developed for Insert Club to generate 3D forms from techno sound. A real-time sound analysis coupled with 3D flocking and wander behaviors creates unique 3D objects. The generated objects are directly exported to a 3D printer format to print them, thus, obtaining physical sounds.
